synopsis:
After being granted a second life, now-teenage Arthur Leywin—an unparalleled, ruthless king in his previous life—has finally become an adventurer with the help of his mentor, Jasmine Flamesworth. Although he is still far from his ultimate goal of becoming more powerful than in his past life, Arthur demonstrates remarkable skill in adventuring, exceeding everyone's expectations.

Meanwhile, Arthur's elven friend and Elenoir Kingdom's princess, Tessia Eralith, has also started adventuring. Due to the prolonged hostility between humans and elves, her duty is to spread goodwill and create friendly relations with human kingdoms. However, as a mysterious group threatens to harm the races' fragile relationship, both Arthur and Tessia soon find themselves becoming pivotal parts of a larger change for the better.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Después de que se le concediera una segunda vida, el ahora adolescente Arthur Leywin, un rey despiadado e incomparable en su vida anterior, finalmente se convirtió en un aventurero con la ayuda de su mentora, Jasmine Flamesworth. Aunque todavía está lejos de su objetivo final de volverse más poderoso que en su vida pasada, Arthur demuestra una habilidad notable en la aventura, superando las expectativas de todos.

Mientras tanto, la amiga elfa de Arthur y princesa del Reino de Elenoir, Tessia Eralith, también ha comenzado a aventurarse. Debido a la prolongada hostilidad entre humanos y elfos, su deber es difundir la buena voluntad y crear relaciones amistosas con los reinos humanos. Sin embargo, mientras un grupo misterioso amenaza con dañar la frágil relación entre las razas, tanto Arthur como Tessia pronto se convierten en partes fundamentales de un cambio mayor para mejor.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
